title: Minimum velocity expression
description: Essential: The final answer must be expressed as v_min = sqrt(2gh) / tanθ or an equivalent algebraic form.

title: Vertical velocity calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply kinematics to find the vertical speed upon impact as sqrt(2gh).

title: Angle condition application
description: Important: The solution must relate the vertical and horizontal velocities using the condition tanθ > v_y / v_0 or its equivalent.

title: Inequality handling
description: Important: The solution must correctly manipulate the inequality to solve for the minimum initial horizontal velocity v_0.

title: Physical interpretation
description: Optional: The solution may explain that the condition ensures the impact angle is less than the critical angle θ.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly using the angle condition (e.g., using sinθ or cosθ instead of tanθ) should be penalized.

title: Kinematics error
description: Pitfall: Making an error in the free-fall kinematics, such as using v_y = gt without relating to height h, should be penalized.
